values: Executive Summary — Meta Insights refreshed Aug 13, 2026 | Latest complete daily data: Aug 11, 2026

Aug 10–11: Instagram delivered 11,218 views, 224 interactions and 17 follows; Facebook added 820 views, 21 interactions and 17 visits. Instagram's two-day views are already 2.4× the full Aug 3–9 week (4,702).

Growth is concentrated on Instagram while Facebook remains below last week's full-week volume. Keep the Spanish/local storytelling that is driving reach, then add one clear message or trial CTA to turn attention into inquiries.

Strongest acceleration in the portfolio: Aug 10–11 produced 972 Facebook views and 2,890 Instagram views—about 4.5× and 3.9× the respective Aug 3–9 totals. Instagram also generated 465 profile visits and 69 interactions.
Only four Instagram follows came from 465 profile visits. Tighten profile conversion: sharpen the bio offer, pin the clearest beginner/trial post and use one consistent enrollment CTA.
Aug 10–11 reached 431 Facebook views—nearly the entire Aug 3–9 total of 445—and 935 Instagram views versus 601 last week. The two platforms generated 106 visits and five follows in two days.
Momentum is improving, but conversion remains modest. Repeat the food/video formats creating reach and connect each post to a single action: visit, reserve, message or follow.
No new Meta refresh was available in the connected business portfolio. The workbook therefore retains the prior social snapshot through Aug 9 and Shopify figures from Aug 4.
Resolve account access before interpreting trend changes. Until then, treat SGS comparisons as stale and avoid reallocating budget based on these figures.
Aug 10–11 is a partial week, so the comparison is directional—not a completed week-over-week result.
Clark has the clearest breakout signal: both Facebook and Instagram surpassed the prior full week's views within two days.
Cobrinha PR remains the scale leader on Instagram, with 11,218 views and 17 follows in the partial week.
Priority across all active accounts: improve profile-to-follow/message conversion while preserving the formats currently driving reach.
